{{Quote|We do not need Ludo Kressh or his factions.|Naga Sadow to his remaining supporters in the Sith Council|<ref name="fabric" />}}
'''Ludo Kressh's faction''' was a collection of several [[Sith Council]] members, [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]], and their respective systems that broke off from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] to oppose its newest [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], around the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. These factions opposed Sadow and his forces, both philosophically and militarily, under the lead of the former Sith Council member [[Ludo Kressh]]. Originally forced to engage in sudden, concentrated acts against Sadow and his supporters, the group eventually seized total control of the Sith Empire. It eventually crumbled after the loss of Kressh, and a devastating invasion by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
===Growing divide===
{{Quote|There can only be one Dark Lord of the Sith.|Ludo Kressh|<ref name="funeral">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>}}
After the natural death of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]], with no immediate successor to follow, the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] was in desperate need of leadership. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]], a presiding member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Council|Council]], and a popular candidate for the next seat of Dark Lord,<ref name="dss">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> was intent on taking the Empire by the reins and ensuring Ragnos' advances during the [[Golden Age of the Sith|last century]] would be preserved. As Kressh led the procession of Marka Ragnos' [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos|funeral]] in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], his arch-rival [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] challenged his candidacy, claiming that by all rights he should be the next Dark Lord. The two exchanged fierce words until drawing swords and entering into a duel to resolve the dispute. Midway through their battle the two were visited by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Marka Ragnos. For the moment the two halted their squabbling and Ragnos foretold of tumultuous events that were soon to unfold. While Kressh was willing to work past their differences, Sadow would not capitulate to his sworn rival. Soon thereafter, a stray [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] piloted by the [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] landed in the basin of the Valley of the Dark Lords. The siblings were then immediately captured by the local Sith forces<ref name="funeral" /> and shipped off to the [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] on Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], where their fates would ultimately be decided by the [[Sith Council]].<ref name="fabric" /> Kressh wished the two executed from the start, fearing that they were the precursors to a Republic invasion. Sadow, on the other hand, wished to interrogate them and use whatever information he could pry out of them to his advantage.<ref name="funeral" />

Once the ten Council members had gathered in the Citadel, Kressh pleaded his case: that the Daragons were too dangerous to be left alive, and that allowing them to live would lead to an inevitable attack by the Republic. Initially his motion saw support, but both Lord [[Simus]] and Sadow argued that Kressh was acting out of fear--that the prisoners presented a golden opportunity to lead the Sith Empire back to the Republic and to conquest. Despite Sadow and Simus' protests, Kressh's popularity within the Council was enough to convince the other Lords that executing the prisoners was the only way to ensure the Empire's safety. A date for the public execution of the two individuals was set, and Simus was sent down to the lower levels of the Citadel to deliver the news to them personally. Sadow cared little for the Council's decree, so he ordered his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] to [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|attack]] the Citadel to force the Council's hand. Sadow had his Massassi wield Republic-issue blasters found in the prisoners' ship, the [[Starbreaker 12]], to make it appear as if the strike originated from Republic agents. During his staged assault on the Citadel, all witnesses were killed, save the prisoners Gav and Jori, whom Sadow broke out of their cell. Meanwhile, Simus was carried in by his Massassi bodyguard, bewildered to see the carnage surrounding Sadow. Upon seeing his old ally, Sadow shot and killed Simus using the Republic blaster, further cementing the ruse of a ruthless Republic attack.<ref name="fabric" />

===Formation===
{{Quote|I'll take my supporters&mdash;we will never join in your folly! I will be the true Dark Lord!|Ludo Kressh and his followers break from the Sith Council|<ref name="fabric" />}}
Once word of the attack reached the Council chambers, the Sith Lords were convinced that it had indeed been a Republic raid. Naga Sadow soon rejoined them, feigning no knowledge of what had transpired. Kressh scolded Sadow for his perceived lack of foresight, then directed the rest of the Council that the only hope was to raise the Empire's defenses and prepare for an imminent invasion from the Republic. It was at this point that Simus' withered skull was brought in by Council member [[Dor Gal-ram]], stunning many of the other Lords. Sadow took hold of what remained of his former mentor and delivered an impromptu eulogy that eventually evolved into a rallying speech, simultaneously taking the opportunity to make a stab at Kressh's character. He ended his monologue by reasserting his candidacy for Dark Lord.
Much of the Council immediately voiced their support for Sadow as the new Dark Lord, while Kressh pleaded for them to listen to reason. Sadow then demanded that his rival stand down, that he had lost, but Kressh would not give in. As a display of strength, Kressh slammed [[Ludo Kressh's War Sword|his]]<ref name="fabric" /> [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemically]] strengthened<ref name="dss" /> [[Sith sword]] on the floor, shattering it as the room was illuminated by the release of its stored energies. The rebellious Council Lord stormed out in protest along with his supporters, including Council members [[Horak-mul]] and Dor Gal-ram.<ref name="fabric" />

Kressh and his supporters lingered in the Sith Citadel, deliberating on events while Sadow went through the rituals to anoint himself as Dark Lord. Elsewhere in the Citadel, Sadow's Massassi eventually infiltrated the lower chambers, where the Starbreaker 12 was impounded, once more. There they [[Second raid on the Sith Citadel|confronted]] guards loyal to Kressh who had been stationed there earlier. Sadow's Massassi took the guards by surprise and dealt with them quickly, leaving only a small insignia of Sadow's warriors behind.
By the time news of an attack on the hangar had reached Kressh it was already too late, the Massassi and [[Zuguruk|Sith engineers]] loyal to Sadow escaped with the impounded vessel before Kressh and his guards could arrive at the scene. What they saw horrified them, and the first conclusions were of another Republic attack. Upon closer examination of the dead, Kressh stumbled upon the planted insignia of Sadow's, allowing him to piece together that the attack was staged by his treacherous rival.<ref name="pawns" />

===Out From the Shadows===
{{Quote|Gather your forces! With your military might, your fleets of ships, we can make a surprise attack.|Ludo Kressh prepares to retaliate against Naga Sadow|<ref name="pawns" />}}
Upon the realization of Sadow's treachery, Ludo Kressh summoned his closest supporters&mdash;Dor Gal-ram and Horak-mul&mdash;to his Contemplation Chambers on his private world of [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]] to inform them of the betrayal as well as his intentions. Upon his retelling of the events at the hangar, Kressh became so impassioned in his hatred for Sadow that upon thrice calling out his name he [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulverized]] several massive stone statues in the chamber with dark side energies, reducing them to rubble. Once he composed himself he called for all his allies to immediately gather their fleets and prepare for an [[Battle of Khar Delba|invasion of Sadow's fortress world]], [[Khar Delba]], to wrest control of the Empire from him before he could do more damage.<ref name="pawns" />

Once in orbit around Khar Delba, the coalition's fleet of [[Derriphan-class battleship]]s quickly descended to Sadow's personal fortress and opened fire, laying waste to the stone bastion. Kressh ordered that no messages were to be transmitted to the surface and that they were not interested in Sadow's surrender, that his transgressions had been too deep. By all appearances the attack was going better than expected, as the forces of Khar Delba seemed to be putting up little resistance to the warships of Kressh.
Meanwhile, within the confines of the crumbling fortress, Sadow urged Jori to escape before it was too late. Accepting his advice grudgingly, she fled the fortress aboard the Starbreaker 12, not knowing of the [[Tracking device (Sith Empire)|tracking device]] Sadow had planted on it to lead him directly to the Republic. As the Starbreaker entered orbit, Jori managed to narrowly avoid being blasted by the capital ships under Kressh's command, as Kressh cried out in desperation as he witnessed the republic vessel jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
As the battle waged on, a hidden fleet of Sadow's located on the far side of Khar Delba's moon, [[Khar Shian]], appeared and ambushed the faction's forces. At the same time, hidden Massassi [[Sadow'een|sleeper cells]] activated on the ships of both Horak-mul and Dor Gal-ram, brutally murdering both Sith Lords by hand. With the instant loss of two of his battleships, the forces under Kressh were outnumbered and outgunned. [[Sith starfighter]]s surrounded the few remaining battleships under Kressh's command, and his faction's four largest capital ships were forced to beat a hasty retreat back to their slice of the [[Stygian Caldera]].<ref name="flight">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>

===Deception===
{{Quote|The traitor is dead at last.|Naga Sadow, believing his rival to be finally defeated|<ref name="desperate">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
Assuming Kressh would be too cowardly to return, Naga Sadow proceeded with his plan to invade the Republic. Gathering all the Sith Lords with significant military might, Sadow and his followers began to strategize for the upcoming invasion on Khar Delba. The assembly was interrupted, however, when [[Ludo Kressh's flagship]] was identified in orbit. Sadow was dumbfounded as to why his rival would be foolish enough to arrive, only to be defeated once more.
Eventually, a hologram transmission from Kressh himself appeared in the primary display of the meeting chamber. Kressh attempted to inform the other Sith Lords of Sadow's betrayal, but they were unmoved. Sadow ordered Gav to take care of the issue, resulting in a singular blast from one of the fortress' cannons that caused Kressh's flagship to rupture and explode. Debris from the mid-orbit explosion continued to fall for hours over the fortress, while Sadow ordered the final preparations for the mobilization of the [[Sith invasion fleet]] to begin.<ref name="desperate" /> Unbeknownst to Sadow was that Kressh was not actually present within his flagship, but that it was a decoy used to lull Sadow into a false sense of security, and to cease future persecution of Kressh and his remaining followers.<ref name="end" />
Over Khar Shian, fighters, [[Sith dreadnaught|carriers]], and flagships from around the far reaches of Sadow's empire converged in perpetration for the invasion. Although Sadow's military presence in his own empire is almost entirely depleted to swell the numbers of his invasion fleet, he is confidant that his rule is secure, despite protest by Gav Daragon. As Sadow's entire stretch of military might jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] towards the Republic,<ref name="forces">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref> it was this exact detail that the very alive Kressh would exploit.<ref name="end" />

===An Empire Under a New Banner===
{{Quote|You are no longer Dark Lord, Naga Sadow! That title has been stripped from you!|Ludo Kressh confronts the retreating Naga Sadow|<ref name="end" />}}
As Naga Sadow waged his costly [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|war]] against the Republic, Ludo Kressh and his followers acted quickly in retaking the Sith Empire. Soon Kressh was crowned Dark Lord of the Sith, ruler over the civilian populations and those warriors still remaining in the Stygian Caldera, while Sadow was fighting a losing battle against the Republic. At this point Kressh's followers ceased to be limited to a coalition of like-minded Sith Lords and Council members, but instead encompassed the whole of the Sith Empire not away fighting the Republic. Upon Sadow's return to Sith space after defeat at the hands of the Republic, he and his few damaged battleships were met by an armada under the command of the newly ordained Dark Lord Kressh. After an impassioned explanation of the new order of things, Kressh officially declared that Sadow was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the Sith Empire forever. Sadow, proud ruler that he was, would not fall in line to Kressh's commands, and initiated the [[first battle of Korriban]] by ordering his remaining ships attack his enemy. Outnumbered, Sadow's already damaged vessels began giving out, and with nothing left to lose, Sadow ordered his damaged ships to collide into Kressh's new flagship. The impact was sufficient to destroy both ships. Soon after, the Republic forces tailing Sadow arrived and [[Second battle of Korriban|decimated]] what forces Sadow had remaining. Catastrophic damage forced Sadow to [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|flee]] in his only remaining battleship to the remote world of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="end" />

The last vestiges of Sith loyal to Kressh dispersed among the stars with the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor-to-be]], or were forced to flee the descending Republic forces which bombarded the Sith worlds.<ref name="t11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Once the task is complete, the order itself will be wiped from history.|The Obliteration of Kressh codex entry|<ref name="oldRep">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
After learning of his father's demise at the hands of Sadow, and the Sith Empire's further loss against the Republic, [[Elcho Kressh]] set in motion an attempt to regain his father's and the Empire's honor. After years of preparation and alliance-forging, the junior Kressh amassed a massive force comprised of dozens of pirate systems and those disloyal to the Republic. However, Elcho Kressh's premature death caused the alliances that held these armies together to disintegrate before a counter-attack could be made on the Republic.<ref name="kerrant" />

Nearly [[3678 BBY|three centuries later]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] ordered that all information and history regarding the Kressh family and their orders be destroyed.<ref name="oldRep" /> The cause of this was linked to the betrayal of the Emperor's apprentice, [[Exal Kressh]],<ref name="oldRep" /><ref name="blood">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]''</ref> a direct descendant<ref name="BotE 3">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref> of Ludo Kressh. Prior to this edict, the Kressh lineage was considered one of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] noblest, as its predominantly [[Sith (species)/Legends|pure-blooded]] scions over the generations were considered great champions of the Sith cause. Exal Kressh was one such Scion.<ref name="oldRep" />

Despite this edict, the Kressh name and lineage endured, and continued to produce rebellious Lords and Scions well into the future of the Empire.<ref name="swtorEnc">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the Spirit of Horak-mul would later meet the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Horak-mul promised aid to Kallig in exchange for desecrating the temple of the [[Sadow'een]] who had killed him and doomed the faction's attack on Khar Delba. In his introduction to Kallig, Horak-mul declared that Ludo Kressh was the true Dark Lord of the Sith, and he his right hand.<ref name="Bitter Rivalries">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Bitter Rivalries|Hoth}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ludo Kressh and his faction first appeared in [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''Tales of the Jedi: The Golden Age of the Sith'']], a story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, which was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and released in [[1996]]. They later appeared in ''The Golden Age of the Sith''{{'s}} follow-up arc, [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''Tales of the Jedi: The Fall of the Sith Empire'']]. In these appearances, Kressh was illustrated by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]] During these two story arcs, the faction's clash against Naga Sadow's was a major storyline. In ''The Fall of the Sith Empire''{{'s}} first issue, [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Desperate Measures'']], Kressh was seemingly killed and and his faction appeared to disband without his leadership. In the arc's final issue, [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''End of an Empire'']], however, it was revealed that Kressh was not killed, but had staged his death so that he could gather support while Sadow was off at war. Kressh and his faction were later wiped out within the same issue.
